tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi thugs dam gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ tā ra bhaṭ+ṭā ra ka nā māṣ+ṭot+ta ra sha ti kaṃ/ bod skad du/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'phags ma lha mo sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan yid 'ong gru 'dzin na// sna tshogs khams kyis rnam par spras// ljon pa 'khri shing ci yang bkram// 'dab chags du ma sgra 'byin cing*// 'bab chu sna tshogs lhung lhung sgrog /'od zer du mas kun tu dkris// me tog sna tshogs rigs rnams kyi// dri yis kun tu bkang ba ste// yid 'ong 'bras bu du mar ldan// bung ba rnams kyang glu dbyangs sgrog /mi'am ci mo glu snyan len// myos pa'i glang pos kun tu gang*// grub pa rig 'dzin tshogs rnams dang*// dri za rnams kyang glu len pa// chags bral thub pa rnams dang ni// gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs// sa bcu'i dbang phyug la sogs dang*// rig pa'i rgyal mo stong gis kyang*// 'phags ma lha mo sgrol ma ni// rtag par yongs su bsten pa ste// gzhan yang khro bo'i rgyal po'i tshogs// rta mgrin la sogs rnams kyis bskor// sems can kun la phan brtson pa// bcom ldan 'das ni spyan ras gzigs// bzhugs pa de phyir dpal dang ldan// pad+ma'i snying po'i khrir gnas shing*// dka' thub chen po dang ldan pa// byams pa dang ni snying rje ldan// lha yi 'khor ni chen po la// chos kyang ston pas bzhugs pa ni// gnas 'dir lag na rdo rje ni// stobs chen mchog tu brtser ldan pa// bzhud nas spyan ras gzigs la zhus// chom rkun sbrul dang seng ge me// glang po stag dang rgyal po chu// sems can 'jigs pa zhi mdzad cing*// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying ba dang*// kun 'gro'i zhags pas bcings pa rnams// chags sdang gti mug dri ma las// gang gis sems can grol 'gyur ba// thub pa chen po bdag la gsungs// de skad gsol nas 'jig rten mgon// dpal ldan spyan ras gzigs kyis ni// phyag na rdo rje rab rtogs slad// snyan pa'i gsung gis bka' stsal pa// nyon cig gsang ba'i rgyal dbang po// skyob pa 'od dpag med pa yi// smon lam dbang gis rab 'khrungs pa// 'jig rten yul du bdag gis shes// thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas// 'gro ba sgrol bar brtson mdzad ma// nyi ma 'char ka dang mtshungs shing*// dri med zla ba nya ba'i 'od// lha dang lha min yid can rnams// de dag thams cad gsal bar mdzad// mchog sbyin ut+pal lnga ldan phyag

/'jig rten gsum la thugs brtse bas// 'jigs pas skrag par gyur pa la// ma 'jigs ma 'jigs zhes gsungs shing*// nam mkha' la gnas mi pham ma// 'brog dgon mtshon cha sna tshogs pa// gnas pa'i 'jigs pas kun 'khrugs las// 'gro ba yang dag srung don du// bdag gis sems can bsgral bgyi zhes// lha mo'i mtshan ni dran pa yis// sna tshogs 'jigs pa'i rgya mtsho las// sems can sgrol bar zhal bzhes pa// des na bdag la 'jig rten du// skyes mchog thub pas sgrol mar bsgrags// bar snang la gnas thub pa la// de nas thal mo sbyar byas te// rmad byung gus dang bcas pa yis// tshig 'di dag ni rab zhus pa// gang zhig rgyal bas sngon bsgrags pa'i// mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad bdag gis brjod// sa bcu'i dbang phyug mgon rnams dang*// byang chub sems dpa' rdzu 'phrul che// sdig pa kun 'phrog bsod nams dang*// bkra shis grags pa 'phel bar byed// nor dang 'bru dang nad med pa// de bzhin rgyas shing 'phel bar byed// sems can la dmigs byams pa yis// thub pa chen pos de skad bsgrags// de ltar brjod nas bcom ldan 'das// spyan ras gzigs ni rab tu bzhad// phyogs rnams thams cad rnam gzigs nas// 'di ltar byams pas spro ba yi// g.yas pa'i phyag gis dul mdzad nas// yongs rdzogs mtshan gyis brgyan pa yi// shes rab chen pos 'di skad gsungs// legs so legs so dka' thub che// sems can kun la mnyen gshin pa// kalpa chen po'i mi rnams nyon// yid can gang zhig 'di sgrog pa// lha dang lha min gang dag 'phel// nad rnams thams cad rnam par grol// dbang phyug yon tan kun dang ldan// dus min 'chi ba nges par sreg /shi nas bde ba can 'gro ba// de ni bdag gis bshad par bya// lha mo seng ge'i khrir bzhugs ma// de ni thub pa'i brtul zhugs kyi// chos la rjes su yi rangs gyis// ༈ /oṃ dge ba can ma gzi brjid can// 'jig rten gso byed grags byed ma// mtsho ldan ma dang spyan yangs ma// shes rab dpal dang blo 'phel ma// gso sbyin ma dang rgyas sbyin ma// oṃ mdzad ma dang 'dod gzugs ma// sems can kun la phan brtson ma// g.yul las sgrol ma rgyal ba ma// lha mo shes rab pha rol phyin// 'phags ma sgrol ma yid 'ong ma// rnga chen dung chen rgyal ba ma// rig sngags rgyal mo tshig snyan ma// zla ba'i zhal ma dkar chen ma// mi pham ma dang gos ser ma// sgyu ma chen mo dkar mo che// stobs chen ma dang pha rol gnon// gtum po chen mo drag mo che// gdug pa'i sems can 'joms byed ma// rab tu zhi ba zhi gzugs ma// rnam par rgyal ba 'od 'bar ma// rnam gsal phreng ldan rgyal mtshan ma// ral gri gzhu dang 'khor lo can// rmugs byed rengs byed nag po ma// dus mtshan ma dang mtshan rgyu ma// srung byed rmongs byed zhi ba ma// mdzes ma dge ma 'gro lding ma// tshangs pa mo dang rig byed yum// gsang ba ma dang phug gnas ma// bkra shis bde byed zhi ba mo// rig byed rig ma yid mgyogs ma// thod pa can ma shugs can ma// mtshan ldan bden ma gzhan mi thub// ded dpon snying rjer gzhug pa ma// 'dren byed las ni rab mthong ma// mchog steng bstan ma ston pa ma// bud med gzugs la dpag med gnon// ri khro ma dang rnal 'byor ma// grub pa gtum mo bdud rtsi ma/

brtan ma nor can bsod nams ma// skal chen skal bzang mthong dga' ma// mthar byed skrag ma 'jigs byed ma// drag mo mi bzad dka' thub che// 'gro la gcig tu phan brtson ma// skyabs med gus la mnyen gshin ma// ngag gi dbang phyug zhi khro ma// rtag don kun 'gro rjes 'gro ma// don kun 'grub byed bzang po ma// sbed ma ma ma nor ster ma// 'jigs med bsod nams rigs mchog ma// dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang bdag sras/ ༈ /yon tan mtha' yas sgrol ma'i mtshan// bsam pa thams cad yongs gang ma// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bstod pa ni// mchog tu brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'di// lha mo rmad byung rnyed dka' ba// sngon gyi rgyal bas gang bsgrags pa// skal bzang skal ba ldan byed cing*// sdig pa thams cad nyams par byed// mchog gi dngos grub thams cad dang*// sems can kun la bde byed pa// blo ldan mnyam gzhag gtsang sbra bya// gang zhig dus gsum klog byed na// de nas dus mi ring ba ru// rgyal srid dpal ni thob par 'gyur// sdug bsngal rtag tu bde bar byed// dbul po rnams ni nor ldan 'gyur// rmongs pa shes rab chen por byed// the tshom med par yid gzhungs 'gyur// bcings pa rnams ni 'ching las grol// tha snyad kun las rgyal bar byed// dgra bo mdza' bshes 'gyur ba ste// rwa can mche ba can rnams dang*// dogs pa'i yul ni brgal dka' ba'i// 'jigs pa sna tshogs 'khrugs pa la// lha mo'i mtshan ni dran pa yis// 'jigs pa de dag thams cad 'joms// dus min 'chi las sgrol bar byed// snyan pa'i grags pa rgya chen thob// mi yi skye ba 'bras bur bcas// bdag nyid chen po de gcig pu// 'di ni snga bar langs byas te// yid can gang zhig sgrog byed na// dpal dang spyod pa blo dang ni// dus ring tshe dang ldan par 'gyur// lha klu de bzhin gnod sbyin dang*// mi dang dri za lus srul po// 'byung po sha za srin po dang*// sdang ba'i sems ldan mang po dang*// mkha' 'gro gnon po yi dwags dang*// skem byed smyo byed gdon chen po// grib gnon dang ni rjed byed dang*// byad stems byed pa la sogs dang*// ro langs sna tshogs la sogs pa// gzhan yang gdug pa'i sems ldan rnams// grib ma yang ni 'gom mi 'gyur// slar yang ji ltar rtsod par byed// gdug pas 'ching bar mi nus shing*// nad kyis thebs par mi 'gyur ro// longs spyod dbang phyug yon tan ldan// bu dang tsha bo 'phel 'gyur zhing*// skye ba dran pa'i blo can 'gyur// blta na sdug cing rigs dang ldan// shes rab spobs pa cher ldan zhing*// bstan bcos kun la 'jigs med gyur// dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang dag bsten// byang chub sems kyis rnam brgyan zhing*// gang nas gang du skyes pa der// rtag tu sangs rgyas kyis mi spangs// zhes 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis gsungs pa'i 'phags ma lha mo sgrol ma dge ba can ma'i bstod pa rdzogs so// 'di la 'gyur snga phyi mang du 'dug na'ang slar gyis rgya gar gyi dpe kha yar la gtugs nas/

dpal sa skya lo tsā ba shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dag par bsgyur ba'o// ༈ /sgrol ma'i mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i bdag nyid shes rab dngos// dpal lha mo der phyag byas nas// de mnyes bya ba'i cho ga ni// shin tu gsal bar bri bar bya// bde ba can gyi 'jigs rten gyi khams su mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa des/ 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa sangs rgyas gzhan gyi zhing du'ang mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig mdzad pa las/ mi brjed 'dir yang skyes pas 'dul ba la spyan ras gzigs dang*/ bud med kyis 'dul ba la rje btsun sgrol ma'i skur sprul nas/ sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no// de yang 'dzam bu'i gling gi lho phyogs ri gru 'dzin zhes bya ba'i steng na ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor lha shas che ba la chos gsung la/ 'og na rje btsun sgrol ma 'khor klu dang lha ma yin shas che ba la chos gsung ste/ sprul pa'i sku yi gtso bo gnyis ni de na bzhugs pa yin no// gzhan yang ri de na sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa byang chub sems dpa' du mas gang nas bzhugs pa yin no zhes 'byung ngo*// de la ri der sangs rgyas kyis sgrol ma'i rgyud kyang gsung pa yin no// de yang sgrol ma rgya mtsho'i rgyud ces bya ba gsungs nas/ gsungs pa tsam gyis sems can gyi don byas nas/ ma 'ongs pa'i sems can la mkho bar mi 'gyur ba'i phyir rgya mtshor nub bo// de'i rjes su rgyud chung ba zhig gsungs nas kyang de bzhin du nub bo// de nas ma 'ongs pa'i sems can gyi don du sgrol ma mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud gsungs/ spyan ras gzigs ku ru kul+le zhes bya ba'i rtog pa gsungs so// de la mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud la brten nas slob dpon klu sgrub kyis sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs mdzad de/

sems can rnams la rgya cher bstan pa yin no// 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis slob ma ba liṃ ta pa la/ des sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ des mar me mdzad bzang po/ des dpal bde ba/ des bi ma la gup+ta la/ des rin chen rdo rje la/ des rat+na kīrti la/ des ben+da pa chen po la/ des dge bshes gnyan lo tsā ba chen po la/ des gnam kha'u pa la/ gnyan dang kha'u pa gnyis ka las sa skya pa chen pos gsan/ des bdag la ste brgyud pa'o// rje btsun ma'i mngon par rtogs pa 'di la don drug ste/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ thun mtshams su gtor ma dang*/ srung 'khor dang*/ chom rkun 'ching ba dang*/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang gzungs sngags kyi lung blang zhing gdon pa'i cho ga'o// de la dang po bsnyen pa ni/ dbang thob pa'am min kyang 'jug pa sems bskyed byas pa'i gang zag sdom pa dang ldan pas gdong la sogs pa dag par byas te bde ba'i stan la bsdad la bdag dang sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la gzhug par bya ba'i phyir rje btsun sgrol ma bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa'i sems bskyed pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pas 'di ltar bsgom par bya ste/ rang gi snying gar pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge tām̐ ljang gu bsgom mo// de las 'od 'phros pas rje btsun ma la bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ de la yid las byung ba'i me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa lnga sngags dang bcas pas dbul/ de'i spyan sngar gur las byung ba'i tshigs su bcad pas yan lag bdun pa bya ste/ de'ang 'di skad du/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gis sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces bya bas so// de yang yan lag bdun du ji ltar zhe na/ rkang pa dang po gnyis rten gyi spyan sngar sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ rkang pa gsum pas dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang ba dang*/ rkang pa bzhi pas don dam byang chub sems bdag med par bsgom pa dang*/ lnga pa dang drug pas skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ de nas tshigs su bcad pa gcig gis smon pa'i bdag nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa dang*/ de nas rkang pa gcig 'jug pa'i bdag nyid kyi byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'o// mjug gi rkang pa gcig gis yongs su bsngo ba ste bdun no// de nas tshad med pa bzhi bsgom par bya ste/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba dam pa dang yun ring du mi 'bral bar gyur cig snyam pa'i dga' ba dang*/ sems can thams cad 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad la snyoms par gyur cig snyam pa'i btang snyoms te bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa snang ba mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid du bsgom mo// de nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang las lha'i sku sgyu ma lta bur langs la sems can gyi don bya snyam pa dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ tām̐ las ut+pal tām̐ gyis mtshan pa de las 'od zer phar 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus pa las bdag nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i cha byad can/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ stod g.yogs dar phra mos nu ma bkab pa/ dbu skra li ba g.yon phyogs gyen du brdzes pa/

g.yas phyogs na mar cung zhig 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon thugs kar ut+pa la'i rtsa ba bzung nas me tog gis rna ba'i thad kar slebs pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can gyi skur bsam par bya'o// de nas de'i thugs kar pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge tām̐ bsam/ de'i 'od kyis po ta la nas rje btsun sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ de la me tog la sogs pa'i pū dza lngas mchod la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur cig /ces brjod la/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod par bsam zhing*/ bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang bas dbang bskur nas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ spyi bor don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas dbang bskur gyi lha de rnams rje btsun sgrol ma'i skur gyur nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas dgug gzhug byas pas de rnams bdag gi lus la thim par bsam mo// de nas ut+pala'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ de yang thal mo sbyar la sdigs mdzub gnyis kyis gung mo'i sen mo bkang ste srin lag gnyis nang du bcug la mthe bos mnan pa ni ut+pal kha bye ba ste/ 'di dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga dang*/ dpung mgo gnyis te gnas lngar gtugs shing yi ge bcu pa tshar re bzlas pas byin gyis brlab par bya'o// de nas sngags bzla bar bya ste/ snying gar tām̐ yig la yi ge bcu pa kha dog dkar po mgo gyen tu bstan pas bskor bar bsams la/

de la klog dar lta bu'i tshul du dmigs la bzla bar bya ste/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes bya ba 'bum phrag bcu gsum bzla bar bya'o/ zhes gsungs na'ang 'bum phrag brgyad cus grangs kyi bsnyen pa rdzogs pa yin no// thun mtshams su gtor ma la sogs pa bya ste 'og tu brjod par bya'o// sngon du bsnyen pa ste dang po'o// gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i gang zag gis/ maṇ+ḍal la brten te dbang du bya bar 'dod na/ gnas dben par zangs la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal dmar po zhig la me tog gi tshom bu lnga bkod la pū dza lnga bsham/ gtor ma'ang dmar po bshams la/ snga ma bzhin tshogs gnyis bsags pa sngon du song nas/ pad+ma dang zla ba la tām̐ yig dmar po las ut+pal tām̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo/ g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon ut+pal 'dzin par bsgom te/ de la dbang bskur ba dang ye shes pa gzhug pa dang gnas lngar byin gyis brlab pa snga ma bzhin du byas la/ de nas rang gi snying gar tām̐ yig dmar po las rje btsun ma rang 'dra ba dpag tu med pa spros te/ rgyal po la sogs pa gang dbang du byed pa de'i snying gar lcags kyus phug mgrin pa ut+pa la'i zhags pas bcings te mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bdag la gus pa'i tshul gyis 'gyel bar bsam/ de nas yang snying ga'i tām̐ gyi 'od dmar pos de'i lus la phog pas dmar lam lam song bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā che ge mo bha swā na ma na ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba'i sngags bzla'o// thun 'jog khar bsgrub bya bdag la bstims la gtor ma gtong ste ji ltar bde bar spyad par bya'o// de ltar thun bzhi'i nges pas zhag bco lnga na 'grub par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa sgrub pa'o// de nas gsum pa thun mong du gyur pa thun mtshams kyi bya ba gtor ma gtang bar 'dod na/

bdag nyid kyi kha lho phyogs po ta la'i phyogs su lta ba'am dngos su ma grub na bltas par bsam/ rdo rje'i skyil krung bya ba'am byas par bsam/ lag pa rdo rje thal mo kha sbyar la gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho tshad med par byin gyis brlab/ ri bo po ta la nas rje btsun ma bdag la thugs rjes dgongs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs par bsams la/ de'i ljags kyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ sngags 'di skad du/ na maḥsarbā bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ/ he he bha ga wa te ma hā satwā sar+b+ba bud+dhāḥ.a wa lo ki te/ mā bi lam+ba/ bā bi lam+ba/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇā pa ya gṛh+ṇā pa ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ sar+b+ba bi sañca re swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas dbul/ de nas rjes btsun mas bdag la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ gzhan yang 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las thar bar mdzad du gsol zhes bya ba dang*/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i mthar rang 'dod pa'i don gzhan yang gsol ba gdab gsungs so// gtor ma'i cho ga'o// bzhi pa srung 'khor ni/ zla ba yar gyi ngo'i tshes grangs kha yar ba la/ ras sam shog bu'am gro ga'am shing shun la/ snag tsha ni/ skyes pa srung ba la gur gum/ bud med srung ba la ghi waṃ gis bris te/ rtsibs brgyad pa lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar oṃ dang hā'i bar du che ge mo la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes pa bri/ rtsibs brgyad la/ tā/ re/ tuta/ tā/ re/ tu/ re/ swā zhes pa brgyad g.yas skor du bri/ mu khyud la kā li g.yas skor/ ā li g.yon skor du bri/ yang na nang gi mu khyud la ā li g.yon skor/ phyi'i mu khyud la kā li g.yas skor du bris la/ de nas maṇ+ḍal bya/ zangs gzhong la sogs par 'khor lo bzhag la rang rje btsun mar bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/

zhes bya ba'i sngags brjod pas 'khor lo stong par bsam/ de'i ngang las tām̐ gyur pa las sngags kyi 'khor lo bris pa ji lta ba bzhin bsam/ de'i yi ge rnams dang snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs la de la bstim/ de nas mchod pa 'byor tshad dbul/ de nas rje btsun ma'i gtor ma'ang gtang*/ de nas 'khor lo de dril la rang ngam gzhan gang yin pa'i skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon/ bud med kyi g.yas/ gang rung gi mgul du btags na srung ba'i mchog go /lnga pa chom rkun 'ching bar 'dod pas/ bdag nyid rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas te kha po ta lar bltas la lag pa thal mo kha sbyar la/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma ri bo ta la'i brag gseb nas bdag la thugs rtse gcig tu dgongs par bsams la gus pa bya/ de nas bdag gi dbugs phyir rgyu ba'i dus su sna g.yon nas 'od zer song nas/ rje btsun ma'i shangs g.yas par zhugs/ shangs g.yon nas 'od byung nas bdag nyid ji srid du 'gro dgos pa'i gnas nas bskor te rang gi gos la sogs pa la sna gtad mdud pa byas/ dbugs bsdams la gom pa nyi shu rtsa gcig tu 'gro/ de'i bar la gzungs sngags 'don de ltar byas na zla ba gcig gi lam du 'gro'ang thub la/ nyin mo byas na srod la bsdu/ mtshan mo byas na tho rangs bsdu'o// ma bsdus na de'i khongs na gnas pa rnams la gnod pa'i phyir ro// shin tu 'jigs pa che ba'am rkun po yod du dogs na/ bla ma ba ri ba'i gdams pa ni/ mu stegs gcer bu sngo krong nge ba phrag pa g.yas la ber ga bkal ba'i mdun phyogs su rnga btags/ rgyab ngos su ḍā ma ru bkal ba gnyis g.yas g.yon gnyis na re re 'dug par bsam mo// des gcan gzan gdug pa can dang chom rkun la sogs pa thams cad thub par 'gyur ro// chom rkun 'ching ba bstan pa'o// drug pa mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang*/

gzungs sngags kyi lung blang zhing gdon pa'i cho ga la gnyis te/ lung blang ba dang*/ gdon pa'o// dang po la gnyis te/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung dang*/ dam bca' ba'i lung ngo*// de la dang po mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i rjes su bzlas pa'i lung len par 'dod na/ gtor ma bcas nas slob mas phyag btsal te me tog lag tu bzung bas thal mo sbyar te/ slob dpon rje btsun sgrol ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan par bsam/ de'i gsung gis bdag la byin gyis rlob par bsams la/ slob dpon gyi rjes su snying po dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa lan gsum gsum bzla'o// de nas gnyis pa dam bca' ba'i lung ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus deng nas bzung nas/ ji srid snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ rje btsun ma'i snying po 'di snyed cig ce'am gzungs sngags 'di snyed cig ce'am/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'di snyed cig 'don par dam bca' ba lags so// zhes slob dpon gyi rjes su lan gsum bzla'o// de nas me tog de dag bla ma la dbul bar bya'o/ bla mas kyang slar slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag go /de phyin chad bla ma dang byin rlabs mnyam bor 'byung gsung ngo*// de nas 'don par 'dod na rje btsun ma'i zhabs g.yas kyi mthe bong bdag gi dpral bar reg cing*/ spyi bor mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya reg pas byin gyis brlabs par bsams la gzungs sngags dang bstod pa 'don na/ thon pa dang spyi bo nas mar thim pas byin rlabs zhugs par bsam mo// de la gzungs sngags ni 'di yin te/ na ma ar+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi sa twa ya/ mahā satwā ya/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ta re tut+tā re tu re/ ma ma kṛ te/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ pra duṣ+ṭaṃ/ dzaṃ bha ya/ staṃ bha ya/ mo hā ya/ bhin+dha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ s+t+waṃ bha ni tā re swā hā/

gzungs sngags so// mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa ni logs su brjod par bya'o// drug pa mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa gzungs sngags dang bcas pa'i lung blang ba'i cho ga bstan zin te/ thams cad kyang bstan zin to// klu sgrub ye shes zhabs las 'ongs pa yi// sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs dug chu spangs pa 'di// legs par bkod las byung ba'i dge ba des// 'gro kun 'od dpag med par thob par shog /rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mngon par rtogs pa yan lag drug dang ldan pa/ dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba rdzogs so// ༈ /'phags pa klu sgrub kyi thugs dam gnyan sgrol gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs so// na mo gu ru rat+na war+dhā ya/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi thugs dam gnyan gyi sgrol ma sgrub par 'dod pas/ gnas dben par bla ma dang dkon mchog la skyabs 'gro byas pa'i mthar/ bdag gzhan 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge tām̐ ljang gu/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang rje btsun ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ de la oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes pa rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ thal mo sbyar la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi zhes sogs lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig ces sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs kyis snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i sgyu ma'i snang ba lta bu de nyid tām̐ las ut+pal ljang gu tām̐ yig gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus tām̐ yig ut+pal dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis ut+pa la'i rtsa ba thugs kar bzung ste 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ zhal 'dzum zhing rab tu zhi ba/ dbu skra li ba g.yon phyogs su brdzes shing*/ g.yas ngos nas mar cung zad 'phyang ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i cha lugs can/ zla ba la sku rgyab brten pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar srab mo'i stod g.yogs kyis nu ma bkab cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig ljang gu/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas po ta la nas rje btsun sgrol ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ gong ltar mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi// khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag

chu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ dbang gi lha de rnams rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i skur gyur te rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ thal mo sbyar ba'i mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i rgyab tu sbyar/ srin lag gnyis nang du bcug la mthe bos mnan pa ut+pala'i phyag rgya/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga dpung mgo gnyis dang bcas par reg cing yi ge bcu pa tshar re brjod pas byin gyis brlabs te/ sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems yun ring du gtad/ skyo na/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du tām̐ yig gi mthar yi ge bcu pa kha dog dkar po mgo bo gyen du blta bas bskor bar bsams la/ de la klog pa'i tshul du/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes yi ge bcu pa gtso bor bzla/ spro na/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re/ ma ma kṛ te/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ pra duṣ+ṭaṃ/ dzaṃ bha ya/ s+t+wam bha ya/ mo ha ya/ ban+dha ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ s+t+wam+bha ni tā re swā hā/ zhes gzungs sngags ci nus bzla/ mthar 'dod don zhu/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par zhu ste rang la thim par bsams la bsngo ba dang smon lam bya zhing*/ spro na thun mtshams su rje btsun ma mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i zhabs kyi mthe bong rang gi dpral bar reg cing*/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bdag gi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs par bsam zhing mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang*/ gzungs ring ci nus kyi mthar phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gis bstod de/ mjug tu rang la thim par bsam mo// de lta bu'i sgo nas yi ge bcu pa 'bum phrag bcu gsum mam 'bum phrag brgyad cus grangs kyi bsnyen pa rdzogs pa yin no// sgrub pa'i sgo nas dbang du bsdu ba/

gtor ma'i cho ga rang gzhan la srung 'khor gdags pa'i cho ga chom rkun srung thabs/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang*/ gzungs sngags kyi lung blang ba'i cho ga rnams ni rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa las rtogs par bya'o// gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i cho ga 'di ni btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis rje btsun rin po che'i gsung rab las logs su bkol te ngag 'don bde bar sbyar ba'o// gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na dkar cha bzhi'i nang nas 'byung ba'i cho gas dbul lo// ༈ /gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa bzhugs so// tā re na mo/ 'phags pa klu sgrub dang*/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs sogs nas brgyud pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi thugs dam gnyan gyi sgrol ma'i rjes gnang dang*/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i lung blang ba'i phyag len ni/ maṇ+ḍal dang mchod gtor bshams la/ slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa bya/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du rje btsun ma sgrub thabs ltar bskyed cing yan lag bzhi rdzogs bya/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs la dbul/ bstod pa bya/ gtor ma sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar phul la mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs kyis rgyun bshags bya/ de nas rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du slob dpon la rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos pa byas pas/ de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer ljang gu dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ slob ma'i lus la phog pas sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ de'i ngang las skad cig gis pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/

tām̐ las ut+pal tām̐ gyis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las slob ma rnams sgrub thabs ltar rje btsun mar bskyed/ slar yang slob dpon la mos gus byas pas de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun ma'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ slob ma la thim par bsams la sngags dang dril gsil bya ba ni gzhi dgod pa'o// dngos la gsum las/ dang po rjes su bzlas pa'i lung ni/ slob dpon la rje btsun mar mos pa byas la/ slob dpon khyod kyis bdag la rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i lung dang gsang sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ gsol gdab 'di spyi dang mthun par rgyun bshags kyi mjug tu byas kyang rung ngo*// de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las de 'dra ba du ma byung nas zhal nas 'thon/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba la tām̐ yig ge mthar 'khod par mos pa byas la snying po dang gzungs kyi rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i/ dpal ldan yid 'ong po ta la zhes pa nas/ legs par gdams par gyur la bstod/

'di'i tshig ris gong gi mtshan brgyad cung zad mi gcig pa ni 'gyur gyi khyad yin no// ces pa'i bar slob dpon gyis tshar gcig bklag oṃ dge ba can ni zhes sogs nas/ spyan ras gzigs dbang bdag nyid skyes zhes pa'i bar gyi rjes zlos lan gsum byed du gzhug de man chad kyi phan yon rnams slob dpon gyis tshar gcig klog de nas slob mas bcom ldan bdag gis sogs brjod cing me tog gtor/ slob dpon gyis bcom ldan 'di la sogs brjod cing me tog mgo bor bzhag go /gnyis pa dam bca' ba'i lung ni/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rje btsun sgrol ma yi dam du gzung snyam pa'i bsam pas/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rje btsun ma sgrol ma yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum dang*/ slob dpon gyis bcom ldan 'di la sogs sh+lo ka gcig dang*/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog gtor ro// gsum pa byin gyis rlob pa'i lung ni/ mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma la gus 'dud drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis/ thugs ka nas de 'dra ba'i rje btsun ma mthe bong tsam zhig byon te slob ma'i spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i tām̐ yig dang dbyer med 'dres pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ slob dpon gyis me tog gtor te/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol mas rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams gnas skabs su 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las bskyangs te 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral du gsol/ mthar thug mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes brjod/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang mthun/

'di la thugs dam rgyun du byas na gnyan gyi mgon pos srung skyob mdzad pa yin zhes gsungs so// gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa bya tshul/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po'i gsung bzhin dge slong dkon mchog lhun grub kyis e wam̐ du bris pa'o// skye bo mang po la byed na gzhan rnams 'dra ba las gzungs ring dang mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i lung blang ba dor bas rung ngo*// ༈ /gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa blo dman 'jug bde bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ār+ya tā rā yai/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid shes rab dngos// dpal lha mo der phyag byas nas// gang gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang ni// shin tu gsal ba'i ngag gis bshad// 'phags pa klu sgrub dang sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs sogs nas brgyud pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi thugs dam gnyan gyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bya tshul ni/ gnas dben par stegs bu khebs ldan la mañji sogs kyi steng maṇ+ḍal la dri bzang gi thig le zlum skor gyi khar nas 'bras sogs kyi tshom bu che chung ci rigs gcig de'i mdun du zlum gtor gcig chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas bcas sbreng tshar/ rang nyid stan la 'dug pa'i drung du/ rdor dril/ 'thor nas/ slob ma la dgos pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ 'thor nas/ chab bum bcas bsham/ 'di bla med yin pas rdor dkar ni mi dgos/ mchod pa rnams rdo rje gsor zhing*/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/

ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi d+yā/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dha rmā ra ṇi ta sogs tshar gsum la dril gsil dang rol mo bcas pas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= dam pa'i chos rnams la= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod/ thal mo sbyar la/ bdag gzhan 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ ljang gu/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang rje btsun ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ de la oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes pa rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces pa'i bar lan gsum brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs nas/ gnas par gyur cig gi bar lan gcig brjod pas tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bur gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba sgyu ma ltar snang ba de nyid tām̐ las ut+pal ljang gu tām̐ gyis mtshan pa/

de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus tām̐ yig ut+pal dang bcas pa la thim/ de yongs su gyur ba las rang nyid rje btsun sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis ut+pa la'i rtsa ba thugs kar bzung nas 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ zhal 'dzum zhing rab tu zhi ba/ dbu skra li ba g.yon phyogs su brdzes shing g.yas ngos nas mar cung zad 'phyang ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i cha lugs can zla ba la sku rgyab brten pa/ dar srab mo'i stod g.yogs kyis nu ma bkab cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ yig ljang gu/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas po ta la nas/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ bar gong bzhin/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun// bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyi// khyed kyi bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni sogs nas/ de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas/ shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ dbang gi lha de rnams rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i skur gyur te rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes dang ut+pa la'i phyag rgya bcing bar bya ste/ thal mo sbyar la mdzub mo gnyis kyis gung mo gnyis kyi sen mo bkab ste/

srin lag gnyis nang du bcug pa mthe bos mnan pa ni ut+pal kha bye ba'i rgya ste/ 'di nyid dpral ba dang*/ mgrin pa dang*/ snying ga dang*/ dpung mgo gnyis te gnas lngar gtugs shing*/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā zhes tshar re brjod/ lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems yun ring du gtad/ spro na/ thugs kar tām̐ yig gi mthar yi ge bcu pa kha dog dkar po mgo gyen du blta bas bskor bar gyur/ de la klog pa'i tshul du/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes yi ge bcu pa gtso bor bzla/ spro na/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ mahā sa twā ya/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re/ ma ma kṛ te/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ pra duṣ+ṭaṃ/ dzam+bha ya/ stam+bha ya/ mo ha ya/ bhan+dha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ stām+bha ni tā re swā hā/ zhes gzungs ring ci nus bzla/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim/ tshom bu la rdo rje gsor te/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ las ut+pal ljang gu zhes pa nas/ dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ dbang gi lha de rnams rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i skur gyur te gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs gong bzhin la dharmā ra ṇi mi dgos/ oṃ ār+yā tā re ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du pa d+yāṃ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar rigs 'gre/ dril gsil dang dharmā ra ṇi sogs/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de// phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa tsam mam/

yang na/ glog dang 'dra ba'i spyan mnga' ma nas/ mtha' bral zung 'jug sku la phyag 'tshal lo// bar maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog ltar bya/ gtor ma/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod la/ na maḥsar+b+ba bud+dha bo dhi sa twā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta sha sa nā nāṃ/ he he bha ga wa te ma hā sa twā sar+b+ba bud+dhaḥ.a wa lo ki te/ mā bi lam+ba mā bi lam+ba/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya/ gṛh+ṇa pa ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ sar+b+ba bi sañca re swā hā/ oṃ ār+yā tā rā ar+ghaṃ sogs mchod pa dang*/ lha dang lha min sogs kyi bstod pa gong bzhin/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las bskyab tu gsol/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral du gsol/ byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye zhing myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdun bskyed la dmigs te/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re sogs yi ge bcu pa phreng 'khor dang*/ gzungs ring 'dod gsol bcas bdag bskyed bzhin/ slob ma rnams la chab btang*/ slob mas yon phul/ maṇ+ḍal gyi nas gral mgon nas bkye gral gsham nas bsdus tshar ba dang slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab ste gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir bdag cag gi ston pa tshad med pa'i thugs rje can des gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos rnams bsdu na mdo sngags gnyis las/

sngags kyi theg pa la rgyud sde bzhir bzhugs pa'i bla med ma rgyud du gtogs pa rje btsun sgrol ma'i skor yin/ de la'ang lugs srol mang du yod pa las 'dir bde ba can gyi 'jig rten du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag tu med pas 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa sangs rgyas gzhan gyi zhing khams su mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa las/ mi mjed 'jig rten 'di yang skyes pas 'dul ba la spyan ras gzigs/ bud med kyis 'dul ba la rje btsun sgrol mar sprul nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no// de la dzam+bu'i gling gi lho phyogs ri bo gru 'dzin zhes bya ba'i steng na ār+ya lo ke shwa ra 'khor lha shas che ba la chos gsung la/ 'og na rje btsun ma sgrol ma 'khor klu dang lha ma yin shas che ba la chos gsung ste/ sprul pa'i sku yi gtso bo gnyis de na bzhugs so// gzhan yang ri de na sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa bo dhi satwa du mas gang nas bzhugs so zhes 'byung ngo*// ri der sangs rgyas kyis sgrol ma'i rgyud kyang gsungs te/ sgrol ma rgya mtsho'i rgyud ces bya ba gsungs nas/ gsungs tsam gyis sems can gyi don byas nas ma 'ongs pa'i sems can la mkho bar mi 'gyur ba'i phyir rgya mtshor nub bo// de'i rjes su rgyud chung zhig gsungs nas kyang de bzhin du nub bo// de nas ma 'ongs pa'i don du sgrol ma mngon par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyan ras gzigs ku ru kul+le zhes bya ba'i rtog pa gsungs so// de las mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud la brten nas slob dpon klu sgrub kyis sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs mdzad de sems can rnams la rgya cher bstan to// slob dpon klu sgrub kyis slob ma ba liṃ ta pa la/ des sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs la/ des mar me mdzad bzang po la/ des dpal bde ba la/ des bi ma la gup+ta la/

des rin chen rdo rje la/ des rat+na kīrti la/ des ban+de pa chen po la gnang ngo*// de la gnyan lo tsā bas gsan pa'i tshul ni/ bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba chung dus nas rgya gar du byon kyang*/ gzhon pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis slob gnyer drag po'ang ma mdzad pa ltad mo ka mdzad/ re zhig na mtsho zhig gi mtha' na sgo nga khra gtsig ge ba 'dug nas bton nas khyer ba na/ mtsho kha nas shing lo zhig rlung gis khyer nas mtsho nang du song ba de nya zhig gis khyer nas mtsho steng du song ba dang*/ skad seg ling zer ba zhig byung ba rna bar zhen te/ nang du slebs pa na'ang seg ling seg ling zhes bzlas pas/ slob dpon ma ti'i zhal nas/ bu shing lo nya khyer skad cig byung*// de ring gar byon phyin shod cig /ma bshad na nyes pa chen po byung dogs yod gsungs/ de rnams bshad pas ma legs so// dug sbrul gyi sgo nga yin/ da kho yong gsungs nas/ sdong po la khog brus pa'i nang na slob dpon dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag lo tsā ba sgrol ma'i sku rgyab tu bzhag zangs tshon la gla rtsi byugs pa'i nang du nye gnas sbas te bzhugs pa'i tshe mtshan mo ji zhig na dug sbrul byung ste/ slob dpon ni ma mthong*/ lo tsā ba g.yon nas nyul zhing lce nyug nyug mang po byas kyang sgrol mas bskyabs pas gnod ma thub/ nam langs kyi bar zangs la gla rtsi byugs kyang de 'khyud pas zangs kyi 'og gi nye gnas kyi lus sbang zan zhig pa ltar song*/ lo tsā ba bod du byon dus sgrol ma de bla mas gnang ba bsnams nas byon/ gtsang chu mig sgrol mar grags te lo tsā ba 'jigs pa brgyad ka las bskyabs so// de lta bu'i byin rlabs can snga thog gtsang chu mig gi gtsug lag khang dang phyis su dol chos 'khor gnas na bzhugs par grags kyang deng sang gar bzhugs ni kho bos ma rtogs/ gong ltar gnyan lo tsā bas kha'u pa dang sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po gnyis la gnang*/

de nas rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ grags pa gzhon nu/ bsod nams grags pa/ grags pa tshul khrims/ shes rab rdo rje/ grags bzang pa/ byang chub seng ge ye shes rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bzang po/ kun dga' dbang phyug dkon mchog 'phel ba/ dkon mchog lhun grub/ nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ dpal ldan don grub/ bsod nams mchog ldan/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/ gong dkar ba phrin las rnam rgyal/ gong dkar ba blo gros dbang phyug gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas sogs kyi bar du byon pa dang*/ yang brgyud rim snga ma gong bzhin la/ dkon mchog 'phel nas/ lha mchog seng ge ngor chen sangs rgyas seng ge rje kun dga' lung rig nags dgon pa sbyin pa grags pa/ sa skya pa a mes zhabs kun dga' bsod nams/ rgyal rtse bdag po bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'bum chen kun dga' dpal 'byor/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ rje bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ thar rtse rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' bsam 'grub sogs kyi bar du byon pa dang*/ gzhan yang gong gi brgyud pa de dag la bla ma 'ga' zhig bzhugs pa dang ma bzhugs pa sogs brgyud pa'i rnam grangs phran bu dang bcas pa las nye bar brgyud pa'i rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i rjes su gnang ba la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub nas khyod rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi sogs tshom bu bdun ma tshig lhug gam/ yang na sa gzhi spos chus sogs gang rigs/ tshig lhug ltar na zhu ba'i yon du zhes sbyar/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// de ltar gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/

mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu 'di rje btsun mar bskyed pa la skyabs gnas thams cad kyis bskor ba'i drung du khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum brjod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas/ 'grub par shog de nas rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du slob dpon la rje btsun ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos pa byas pas de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer ljang gu dpag tu med pa 'phros te slob ma'i lus la phog pas sdig sgrib dang bar du gcod pa thams cad sbyangs nas lus 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ de'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du tām̐ las ut+pal tām̐ gyis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las khyed rang rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu zhes pa nas/ g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ slar slob dpon la mos gus byas pas thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs ka nas rje btsun ma'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rnams la thim/ rdo rje g.yab dril bu gsil/ slob ma rnams gu gul gyis bdugs la sngags ring thung bzla/ dril gsil/ spos bdug bzhag la/ de rnams rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa yin/ dngos gzhi la gsum las/ dang po rjes su bzlas pa'i lung ni slob dpon rje btsun sgrol mar mos pa byas la 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon khyed kyis bdag la rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i lung dang sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las de 'dra ba du ma byung zhal nas thon/

slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba la tām̐ yig gi mthar 'khod par mos pa byas la sngags 'di gnyis kyi rjes zlos lan gsum re mdzod/ oṃ tā re sogs yi ge bcu pa dang*/ na mo rat+na sogs gzungs ring lan gsum/ de nas mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i lung bya ba la thog mar gleng gzhi 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ dpal ldan yid 'ong gru 'dzin na zhes pa nas/ chos la rjes su yi rang gyis bar slob dpon gyis tshar gcig blo nas brjod pa'am dpe las bklag de nas khyed rang rnams 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ dge ba nas/ dpal ldan 'jig rten dbang bdag sras par lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon gyis phan yon brjod pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ yon tan mtha' yas sgrol ma'i mtshan nas/ dge ba can ma'i bstod pa rdzogs so bar lan gcig brjod klog gang rung*/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// slob dpon gyis kyang khyed rang rnams la me tog gtor nas/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod pa ni rjes su bzlas pa'i lung yin/ gnyis pa dam bca' ba'i lung ni/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du rje btsun sgrol ma yi dam du gzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du rje btsun sgrol ma yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs sh+lo ka gcig dang*/ rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog gtor ba ni dam bca' ba'i lung yin/

gsum pa byin gyis brlab pa'i lung ni/ mdun bskyed kyi rje btsun ma la gus 'dud drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas de 'dra ba'i rje btsun ma mthe bong tsam zhig byon te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug nas zhugs/ thugs ka'i tām̐ yig dang dbyer med du 'dres pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis me tog gtor te/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol mas rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams gnas skabs su 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las bskyabs te 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral du gsol/ mthar thug mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod pa ni byin gyis brlab pa'i lung yin/ de ltar lung gsum gyi sgo nas rje btsun sgrol ma'i rjes gnang gsan pa yin pas dam tshig bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// rjes gnang thob pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu zhes dang*/ maṇ+ḍal tshig lhug bcad gang rung gong bzhin la lhug pa ltar na thob pa'i yon tu 'bul bar bgyi'o// zhes sogs dang*/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// de rnams kyi sgo nas rje btsun sgrol ma'i rjes gnang gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te// skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /ces brjod la slob ma rang gnas su gtang*/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod gong bzhin/ 'dod gsol bdag bskyed kyi mjug bzhin/

rdor sems yig brgya bzla ba grangs skabs dang sbyar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun 'phags mas bzod par mdzod// oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra muḥtshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'phags ma sgrol ma 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /lha dang lha min sogs gong bzhin la/ sgrol ma yum gyi bkra shis shog /ces sogs ci shes brjod/ bsnyen pa dang rgyun gyi nyams len ni skyabs 'gro nas gdan bsdu ba'i bar byas la/ spro na thun mtshams su/ rje btsun ma mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i zhabs kyi mthe bong rang gi dpral bar reg cing*/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya bdag gi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs zhes dang*/ spro na po ta la nas/ 'gro kun rnam dag zhing du spyod par shog bar/ yang na rgya gar skad nas yi rang gi bar tshar gcig oṃ dge ba nas/ dbang bdag sras bar tshar gsum sogs ci nus/ gzungs ring phreng skor sogs ci nus/ de nas/ oṃ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo zhes sogs phyag 'tshal nyer gcig ci 'grub mthar/ lha mo la gus sogs phan yon brjod pa tshar gcig yan lag bdun pa dang 'dod gsol rgyas par bya'am/ yang na/ dge ba 'di yis zhes sogs gong bzhin/ gtor ma 'bul na/ phan yon dran pa rdzogs 'phral zlum gtor chab kyis bran/ 'bul tshul gong bzhin/ dmigs pa ni/ po ta la nas rje btsun ma'i ljags kyi 'od zer gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam/ tshul de lta bu'i sgo nas yi ge bcu pa 'bum phrag bcu gsum mam/ brgyad cus grangs bsnyen rdzogs pa yin no// las tshogs dbang sdud/

srung 'khor/ chom rkun srung ba gsum gyi steng du/ gong gi sgrub thabs/ rjes gnang*/ gtor ma gsum bsnan pa la yan lag drug par grags shing*/ sbyin sreg byed na lugs 'di dang rjes su 'brel ba nas kha skong dgos te/ de dag rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung rab ltar ro// zhes gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa las yan lag gsum nag 'gros su bkod cing*/ gsum zhar la bstan pa 'di'ang 'brug pa chos rje zhes bya bas bskul ba'i ngor/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis bris pa maṅga laṃ// ༈ /gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam par gzhag pa ut+pal chun po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ār+yā tā rā yai/ 'dir rnal 'byor ma rgyud sgrol ma mngon par 'byung ba la brten nas slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis legs par bkral zhing*/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags kyis spyan drangs te/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la bka' babs pa la 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lung blang ba dang*/ bsnyen pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ gtor ma'i cho ga dang*/ srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ chom rkun 'ching ba ste yan lag drug dang ldan pa'i gdams pa zab mo nyams su blang ba'i tshul la gnyis/ sngon du lung blang ba dang*/ nyams len dngos so// dang po ni/ ngor chen thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa dang*/ de nyid 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyis bklag chog tu bsdebs pa dag gi dgongs don ltar bla ma las nod de dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pas rgyud sbyang bar bya'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor ro// dang po ni/ gnas dben par phyag dar byas te/ sgrol ma'i sku rten bshams pa'i mdun la sogs pa gang bder zlum gtor gcig dang*/ nyer spyod spyi ltar bsham/ rang nyid kha lho phyogs su lta ba 'grigs na rab/

ma 'grigs na mos pa byas pa'i mdun du rdo rje dril bu me tog sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams dang*/ dang por 'jug pa'i sngon 'gror cha gsum gyi gtor ma bcas bshams la/ cha gsum spyi ltar gtang*/ sgo rtsar mtshams tho brtan par gzugs/ mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung rje dkon mchog lhun grub dang*/ 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs gang rigs ltar nyams su blang*/ thun gyi dngos gzhir snying po yi ge bcu pa kho na dang*/ thun mthar gzungs ring yang cung zad bzla/ dmigs pa ni gtso bor sngags phreng la yid gtad de klog pa'i tshul du bzla zhing*/ de la gsal snang khyad par can thob pa na/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pa'i sna la mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab par sprul te 'phags pa rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ sems can thams cad la phog pas 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las bskyabs te sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs nas rje btsun ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu dang khyad par sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las rgyas pa'i dngos grub thams cad 'od zer ljang gu'i rnam par tshur bsdus nas rang la thim par bsam pa'i spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang*/ rang rje btsun ma'i sku snang stong zung 'jug dang*/ sngags kyi sgra grags stong zung 'jug dang*/ dran rtogs thams cad rig tsam rang gi ngo bos stong pa'i zung 'jug brjod bral te rje btsun ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba gsum las nam yang ma yengs pa'i ngang nas sngags bzla ba ni gal che'o// thun bsdu ba na 'dod don gsol gdab gang rigs bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim par bsam mo// gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma a mṛ tas bsang*/

swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ ces dang*/ 'bru gsum lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ lho phyogs po ta la nas sgrol ma 'khor dang bcas pa bdag la thugs rjes dgongs bzhin du bzhugs pas gtor ma gsol bar bsams la nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ na maḥsar+b+ba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ a pra ti ha ta shā sa nā nāṃ/ he he bha ga wa te mahā sa twā sar+b+ba bud+dhaḥ.a wa lo ki te/ mā bi lam+ba mā bi lam+ba/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa pa ya/ gṛh+ṇa pa ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ sar+b+ba bi sañca re swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul nas/ ār+yā tā re sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de// phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yul la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod la/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol mas bdag dang sems can thams cad 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug las bskyab tu gsol/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las bsgral du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam bya/ spro na thun mtshams su rang rje btsun ma'i nga rgyal gyis gnas pas/ rje btsun ma mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sogs nas phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gis bstod de rang la thim pa'i dkyus ltar bya/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis thun bzhi'am gsum du bcad/ snga thun nam phyi thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma dbul/ bsnyen pa'i tshad yi ge bcu pa 'bum phrag bcu gsum bzla ba ni las rung dang*/ 'bum phrag brgyad cu bzlas pas sgrol ma'i sngags rgyud rnams las gsungs pa'i las rab 'byams bsgrub pa la thogs pa med par 'gyur ba yin la/

kha skong gi sbyin sreg byed par spro na gsang ba spyi'i cho ga la 'di nyid kyi lha sngags sbyar bas 'grub par 'gyur zhing*/ gzhan mtshams kyi spang blang dang grol tshul sogs bsnyen thabs spyi ltar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub pa bya bar 'dod na/ bsnyen pa mthar phyin pa des/ maṇ+ḍal la brten te dbang du bya ba ni/ gnas dben par zangs la sogs pa'i maṇ+ḍal la 'bras dmar po'am smug rtsis kha bsgyur ba'i tshom bu bkod la/ nyer spyod dang mdun du gtor ma dmar po gcig bcas bshams la mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa yan chad gong bzhin sngon du song nas/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ tām̐ yig dmar po las ut+pal dmar po tām̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon ut+pal dmar po 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum pa dang sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ dbu skra li ba g.yon phyogs su brdzes shing g.yas ngos nas cung zad 'phyang ba/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i cha lugs can/ dar srab mo'i stod g.yogs kyis nu ma bkab cing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang ba g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du tām̐ yig dmar po sogs nas de la dbang bskur ba dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pa dang*/ gnas lnga byin gyis brlab pa rnams sngar bzhin byas la/ de nas rang gi snying gar tām̐ yig dmar po las rje btsun ma rang 'dra ba dpag tu med pa spros te/ rgyal po la sogs pa gang la bya ba de'i snying gar lcags kyus phug mgrin par ut+pa la'i zhags pas bcings te mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bdag la gus pa'i tshul gyis bkug par bsam mo// yang snying ga'i tām̐ gyi 'od dmar po des lus la phog pas dmar lam song bar bsam zhing*/

oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā che ge mo wa sha ma na ye/ zhes bzla'o// thun 'jog kar bsgrub bya bdag la bstims la/ gtor ma gtang ba sogs gong bzhin bya'o// de lta bu thun bzhi'i nges pas zhag bco lnga nas 'grub par gsungs so// gsum pa las sbyor la/ srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ chom rkun 'ching ba'i man ngag gnyis te rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i yi ge las rtogs par bya'o// zhes pa'ang bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos yig cha snga ma'i don gyi bcud phyung ste bris pa'i dge bas 'gro kun phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing 'dod rgu'i dngos grub yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ ༈ /gnyan sgrol yan lag drug pa'i rjes gnang gi brgyud 'debs ut+pal zil dngar zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rje btsun sgrol ma 'phags mchog klu sgrub che// ba liṃ ta pa sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs// mar me mdzad bzang dpal bde dri med sbas// rin chen rdo rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// rin chen grags pa'i zhabs dang ban+de pa// gnyan lo chen po chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal// kun dga' snying po grags pa rgyal mtshan dang*// sa skya paṇa chen rnams la= /mkhan chen byang chub dpal dang bde ba dpal// grags pa gzhon nu bsod nams grags pa dang*// grags pa tshul khrims shes rab rdo rje'i zhabs// grags pa bzang po rnams la= /byang chub seng ge ye shes rgyal mtshan dang*// ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dbang rgyal tshab rje// dkon mchog 'phel dang lha mchog seng ge'i zhabs// sangs rgyas seng ge rnams la= /kun dga' lung rigs sbyin pa grags pa dang*// kun dga' bsod nams bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal// kun dga' dpal 'byor sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// bstan 'dzin lhun grub rnams la= /nam mkha' bsam 'grub kun dga' blo gros dang*// nam mkha' 'chi med kun dga' bstan 'dzin zhabs// tshul 'di'i bka' drin stsol mdzad bla ma sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs dang*// yan lag drug ldan rnal 'byor zab mo'i mthus// 'phags ma dgyes pa'i phrin las yongs rdzogs te// rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog

/ces pa'ang khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin las tshul 'di'i bka' drin thob pa 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa sid+dhi rastu// sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
